{{Quote|Is this the best Mandalore can offer me? A ''veterinarian'' who spends her working day with her arm up a—"<br />"Believe me, I prefer treating nerfs.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and veterinarian [[Hayca Mekket]]|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
A '''veterinarian''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] qualified to treat diseased or injured animals.

[[Hayca Mekket]] was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] veterinarian, who owned [[Hayca Mekket's veterinary office|veterinary offices]] in [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Mekket, who often treated [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]], was called upon to treat [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. She [[Hypo-syringe|injected]] Fett with a cure for the tumors that were plaguing him in his advanced age, a service for which she only asked for a [[Blanket/Legends|quilt]] in return as payment from the Mandalorian leader.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>
